responsibility: Implements the concrete pattern-binding lowering logic for building borrow-checker IR from Rust HIR patterns. This file walks identifier, reference, slice, struct, tuple, and tuple-struct patterns; derives projected BIR places through deref/field/index paths; propagates optional type annotations and free-region bindings through nested destructuring; declares bound locals with correct ref/mut/reference types; and emits the assignments that attach each bound variable to its initializer place, making it the executable companion to the pattern-builder interface.
same_name_distinction: Within the rust-bir-builder-pattern pair, this .cc file contains the actual visitor method implementations that walk concrete HIR pattern forms and emit BIR bindings and assignments, whereas the header declares the PatternBindingBuilder class interface and its saved-state scaffolding.
